mutants.label: [does-nothing] check never appends a fail result
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_an_existing_entry_is_deleted: this guard's whole purpose is to catch a lost or edited entry.

mutants.label: [control] check drops the base-entries-empty skip
mutants.why: Provably inert: when base_entries is empty the `for base_entry in base_entries` loop below iterates zero times either way, so skipping ahead of it or falling through to it produces the same empty result set. Kept in source purely to skip the needless head-side retired.md read.

mutants.label: check treats any same-id entry as matching regardless of field equality
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_an_existing_entrys_date_is_edited and its sibling field-edit tests: a same-id entry with a changed field must still fail.

mutants.label: check inverts the membership test, failing unchanged entries and passing lost ones
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_when_only_appending_new_entries (an unchanged base entry would now wrongly fail) and test_fails_when_an_existing_entry_is_deleted (a deleted entry would now wrongly pass) together — the positive and negative conjuncts of the same check.

mutants.label: check reports the wrong guard name
check drops the entry id from the fail message
mutants.find:
f"{skill}: retired.md entry {base_entry['id']!r} was "
                        "edited or removed"
mutants.replace:
f"{skill}: retired.md entry was "
                        "edited or removed"

mutants.label: [control] reword the guard module docstring
